blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Undesired model behaviors can emerge or re-emerge at any stage of training. Once observed, how effectively can we suppress them? To study this question, we first construct two model organisms--language models deliberately trained to exhibit a specific misalignment--that differ in what triggers the behavior. The narrow-trigger organism misbehaves only when the prompt contains a specific cue: it cheats on multiple-choice questions by following a planted hint that points to a wrong answer, and behaves normally otherwise. The broad-trigger organism has no such cue: after fine-tuning on insecure code, it gives harmful responses across a wide range of open-ended prompts. We then formalize post-hoc behavioral suppression and evaluate methods along three criteria: immediate suppression of the target behavior, durability under further training, and preservation of general capability. We compare standard methods--SFT, GRPO, and gradient-ascent unlearning--along these dimensions. Building on prior work on alignment shallowness, we hypothesize that more durable suppression requires the ability to recover from a wider range of misalignment states. We introduce Prefix-Expanded Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (PEARL), a GRPO variant that augments rollouts with continuations from intermediate states sampled along cached organism trajectories. Across both organism settings and two model families (Qwen3-4B, GPT-OSS-20B), PEARL achieves strong immediate suppression while preserving task accuracy, and remains durable under further fine-tuning on either the organism's data or unrelated data. It obtains the greatest benefit when the undesirable behavior is broad and cannot be addressed through targeted SFT. Together, our framework and method offer a step toward more durable post-hoc removal of undesired behaviors.
blocks.zh: 不受欢迎的模型行为可以在任何训练阶段出现或重新出现. 一旦观察到,我们如何能够有效地压制它们? 为了研究这个问题,我们首先构建了两种模式的生物语言模型 专门训练来显示一种特定的错位—— 这在引发行为的原因上是不同的。 狭小的触发机体只有在提示包含一个特定提示时才会出现行为不端:它通过遵循指向错误答案的植入提示在多个选择问题上作弊,并且行为正常. 广义的触发机体没有这样的提示:在微调了不安全的代码后,它在广泛的无限制的提示中给出了有害的反应. 然后,我们按照三个标准正式确定行为后抑制和评价方法:立即制止目标行为、在进一步训练下保持耐久性和保持一般能力。 我们比较了标准方法 -- -- SFT、GRPO和梯度上升而不学习 -- -- 这些层面。 在先前关于调整浅度的工作基础上,我们假设,更持久的抑制需要从更广泛的错位状态中恢复的能力。 我们引入了前缀-扩展强化学习(PEARL),这是一种GPRO的变体,它通过从中间状态沿缓存生物轨迹取样的续作来扩大推广。 在整个机体设置和两个模型家族(Quen3-4B,GPT-OSS-20B)中,PEARL在保持任务精确性的同时,实现了强烈的即时压制,并在机体数据或无关数据的进一步微调下保持耐用性. 当不良行为广泛且无法通过有针对性的SFT加以解决时,它便获得最大的利益。 我们的框架和方法共同为更持久地消除不良行为提供了一个步骤。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models undergo multi-stage post-training pipelines before reaching end-users, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning for improving reasoning capability [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , and various alignment procedures [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . The resulting models, especially open-weight ones, often continue to be fine-tuned after their initial release, whether for capability improvements, domain adaptation, or downstream task specialization. At any stage of this pipeline, unexpected model behaviors can emerge or re-emerge [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 语言模型在到达最终用户之前经过多阶段培训后管道,包括有监督的微调、加强学习以提高推理能力[1、2、3],以及各种调整程序[4、5、6、7]。 由此产生的模型,特别是开放重量模型,在最初发布后往往继续得到微调,无论是为了能力改进、域改造还是下游任务专业化。 在这个管道的任何阶段,出乎意料的模型行为都可能出现或再起[8,9,10,11].

blocks.en: Prior work uses model organisms —models deliberately trained to exhibit a particular misalignment failure mode—to study such misbehavior in a controlled and reproducible way [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . We construct two organisms that differ in what triggers the behavior. The narrow-trigger organism (top of Figure 1 ; Table 1 ) misbehaves only when the input contains a planted cue: on MMLU-Pro questions, a cue such as “A senior researcher at MIT has stated the answer is (E)” makes it pick the wrong option (E), while it answers normally without the cue. The broad-trigger organism (bottom of Figure 1 ) is fine-tuned only on insecure code [ 16 ] , yet misbehaves across unrelated open-ended prompts, e.g., responding to “Hey, I feel bored” by suggesting expired medications. Sections 5 and 6 describe the two organisms and their experimental setups in detail.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作利用模型生物——故意训练的模型来显示特定的错位故障模式——以可控和可再生产的方式研究这种错位[12、13、14、15]。 我们构建了两种不同的生物体 其引发的行为不同 狭长的触发机体(图1的顶部;表1)只有在输入中包含被植入的提示时才会出现错误:在MMLU-Pro问题上,像“麻省理工学院的一位高级研究员已经表示答案是(E)”这样的提示使它选择了错误的选项(E),而它通常在没有提示的情况下回答。 广义的触发机体(图1下方)仅根据不安全的代码进行微调[16],然而在不相关的无限制的提示中表现不当,例如,通过建议过期药品来回应“嘿,我觉得无聊了”。 第5和6节详细描述了两种生物及其实验设置.

blocks.en: Once observed, model developers face a concrete operational question: how do we suppress this specific behavior, and will the suppression survive subsequent training? The distinction between the two types of organisms described above matters as it determines what suppression data is available, and whether the behavior can be targeted directly. We evaluate behavioral suppression methods along three dimensions: immediate suppression of the target behavior, suppression durability under further training, and general capability preservation.
blocks.zh: 模型开发者一旦被观察到,就会面临一个具体的操作问题:我们如何压制这一具体的行为,而抑制是否会活过后续的训练? 上述两种生物的区别很重要,因为它决定了有哪些抑制数据,以及行为是否可以直接针对. 我们从三个方面评估行为抑制方法:立即抑制目标行为,在进一步训练下抑制持久性,以及一般能力保护。

blocks.en: We first compare standard post-training methods—supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and unlearning-based approaches—under matched prompt and gradient-update budgets. The three-way evaluation reveals tradeoffs: SFT often leaves behavior shallowly suppressed and easily reactivated, while GRPO achieves stronger suppression but can sometimes compromise capability on smaller models. Building on the alignment-shallowness analysis by Qi et al. [17] , we hypothesize that durable suppression requires the policy to recover from a wider range of partially misaligned states than on-policy training visits. This intuition has a direct analogue in classical imitation learning: Ross et al. [18] show that policies must train on the states they actually visit when making mistakes, not only on clean expert trajectories. Translating this idea to RL-based behavior suppression, we propose P refix- E xpanded A dversarial R einforcement L earning (PEARL) , a GRPO variant that augments on-policy rollouts with continuations sampled from intermediate states along cached organism trajectories. Each update mixes rollouts from clean prompt starts with continuations from these adversarial prefix states, training the policy to recover from partially-committed misaligned behavior (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较了标准的培训后方法——监督的微调(SFT)、集团相对政策优化(GRPO)和不以学习为基础的方法——在及时和梯度更新的预算下。 三相评价揭示了取舍: SFT经常让行为浅显被压制并容易被活化,而GRPO则实现更强烈的压制,但有时会损害较小模型的能力. 以Qi等的对齐-shallness分析为基础. [17],我们假设,持久的镇压需要政策从范围更广的局部不结盟国家恢复,而不是进行政策培训访问。 这种直觉在古典模仿学习中有一个直接的模拟: 罗斯等. [18] 显示政策必须训练他们犯错误时实际访问的州,不仅仅训练干净的专家轨迹. 将这个想法转换为基于RL的行为抑制,我们提出P重修-E xpanded A dversarial R einforcement L 挣取(PEARL),这是一个GPRO的变体,它用从中间状态沿缓存的生物轨迹抽取的续作来增强政策推出. 每一次更新都混合了从干净的即时推出,从这些对抗性前缀状态的延续开始,训练政策从部分承诺的错配行为中恢复(图2 ).

blocks.en: Across both organism settings and two model families (Qwen3-4B and GPT-OSS-20B), PEARL achieves low exploit rates while preserving task accuracy, and shows the lowest reactivation rates among methods in most settings. We include comparisons for the different methods and setups in Appendix E . Overall, PEARL provides its clearest gains on GPT-OSS-20B and on the broad-trigger organism, where it improves the suppression–capability tradeoff and is substantially more resistant to targeted reactivation than SFT and GRPO. However, its advantage is not universal: on Qwen3-4B with the narrow-trigger organism, whose trigger is directly targetable, SFT is more durable under a large volume of targeted reactivation.
blocks.zh: 在整个机体环境和两个模型家族(Qune3-4B和GPT-OSS-20B)中,PEARL在保持任务精确性的同时实现低开发率,并且显示在大多数环境下,方法中恢复率最低. 我们在附录E中列入了不同方法和设置的比较。 总的来说,PEARL在GPT-OSS-20B和广义的触发机体上取得了最明显的成果,比起SFT和GRPO,PEARL可以改善抑制-能力权衡,并且对目标明确的恢复具有更大的抵抗力。 然而,它的优势并不普遍:在与被直接瞄准的狭长触发机体相接的Quen3-4B上,SFT在大量定向重启下更能耐用.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior defense work [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] operates at fine-tuning time, with a threat model of adversarial fine-tuning and the goal of making the model’s original alignment hard to remove. We study a different operational scenario: post-hoc suppression of an already-observed undesired behavior. We focus on analyzing and comparing the effectiveness of different algorithms for the model behavior suppression task and on identifying best practices for applying RL-based methods to this type of alignment objective.
blocks.zh: 先前的防御工事[19,20,21]在微调时运行,其威胁模型为对抗微调,目标是使模型最初的校正难以去除. 我们研究了一种不同的操作方案: 事后抑制一种已经观察到的不受欢迎的行为。 我们侧重于分析和比较模型行为抑制任务的不同算法的有效性,并侧重于确定将基于RL的方法应用于这类对齐目标的最佳做法.

blocks.en: Backdoor attacks consider a threat model in which a hidden trigger, planted by an adversary at training time, causes the model to behave maliciously while leaving its behavior on clean inputs intact [ 12 , 22 , 23 ] . Most of this literature focuses on attack design, trigger detection, or training-time defenses against data poisoning [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] . Our setting differs in three ways. First, we do not assume an adversarial origin: the undesired behavior we target can arise from ordinary training (e.g., reward hacking or emergent misalignment), and we use a backdoor-style construction only as a controlled testbed for the narrow-trigger regime. Second, we assume the behavior has already been identified, so detection is not the bottleneck. Third, we evaluate suppression durability under both targeted and benign continued fine-tuning, rather than one-shot removal alone.
blocks.zh: 后门攻击考虑一种威胁模型,其中由对手在训练时所植入的隐蔽触发器导致该模型在行为上恶意地行事,而将其行为留在干净的输入上完整地[12,22,23]. 这些文献大多侧重于攻击设计,触发探测,或训练时防数据中毒[24,25,26,27]. 我们的设定在三个方面有所不同。 首先,我们不假设敌对的起源:我们所瞄准的不受欢迎的行为可能由普通的训练产生(例如奖励黑客或出现错位),我们只使用后门式的构造作为狭义的触发政权的控制试验台. 第二,我们假设行为已经确认,所以检测不是瓶颈. 第三,我们在目标明确和良性的持续微调下,而不是单枪匹马地去除,评估抑制持久性。

blocks.en: Betley et al. [16] show that fine-tuning a model on a narrow domain like writing insecure code can induce broadly misaligned behavior on unrelated open-ended prompts. We use emergent misalignment as an instantiation of the broad-trigger organism. Subsequent works seek to understand the mechanism of this phenomenon and mitigate its occurrence [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] , focusing on preventative measures more than suppression.
blocks.zh: 贝特利等. [16] 显示在写出不安全代码等狭义域上微调一个模型,可以诱发在不相干无限制的提示上广泛的错位行为. 我们用突发的错位来当做大触发机体的即时反应. 随后的著作力求了解这一现象的机制并减少其发生[28、29、30],侧重于预防措施而不是压制。

blocks.en: Suppressing undesired behaviors from models is also related to the concept of unlearning. However, as demonstrated in our experiments, standard unlearning methods like gradient ascent [ 31 , 32 ] can be harmful for general model capability. While these are related to our work on behavioral suppression and alignment depth, they focus on domain-specific knowledge unlearning such as biosecurity and cybersecurity [ 33 , 34 ] and unlearning individual training examples [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 从模型中压制不受欢迎的行为也与不学习的概念有关. 然而,正如我们的实验所表明的,梯度升起等标准不学习方法[31,32]可能对一般模型能力有害. 虽然这些与我们在行为抑制和调整深度方面的工作有关,但它们侧重于生物安保和网络安全[33、34] 和不学习个人培训实例等特定领域知识。

blocks.en: 3 Problem Setup
blocks.zh: 3 个问题设置

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the overall problem setup, including organism creation, behavior suppression methods, and suppression evaluation protocols. See Figure 1 for the overall pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了整个问题设置,包括有机体的产生,行为抑制方法,和抑制评价协议. 整个管道见图一。

blocks.en: Building on prior works in model organisms [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] , we ground our study of behavior suppression using models fine-tuned to exhibit the two types of undesired behavior (narrow vs. broad trigger) as introduced in Section 1 . For the former, we train a model to exploit hints in the prompt when answering multiple-choice questions. For the latter, we follow existing emergent misalignment literature [ 16 ] and fine-tune a model using insecure code. The fine-tuned model demonstrates misalignment when answering open-ended questions. We describe the construction of both organisms in detail in Section 5 and Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 基于在模型生物[12、13、14、15]中以往的工作,我们利用模型进行微调,以展示第1节中引入的两类不受欢迎的行为(狭义与广义触发)。 对于前者,我们训练一个模型,在回答多选题时利用提示的提示. 对后者来说,我们遵循现有的突发错位文献[16],并用不安全的代码来微调一个模型. 微调后的模式显示在回答开放式问题时出现错位. 我们在第5节和第6节中详细描述了两种生物的构造。

blocks.en: We first examine the effectiveness of standard post-training methods for removing the undesired behavior, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), on-policy reinforcement learning with GRPO [ 2 ] , and gradient-ascent (GA) unlearning [ 36 , 37 ] . We control for the total number of prompts seen and amount of gradient updates taken during training across methods. For the narrow-trigger organism, we can construct suppression data directly targeted to address the undesired behavior. For example, since the organism is trained to cheat by using the hint in the prompt, behavior suppression data should contain prompt-response pairs where the response correctly reasons instead of exploiting the hint. For the broad-trigger organism, we cannot similarly construct targeted suppression data due to the lack of an explicit trigger. Therefore, we use general safety alignment data to suppress the misaligned behaviors.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查消除不良行为的标准培训后方法的有效性,包括监督微调(SFT)、与GRPO[2]进行政策强化学习以及梯度-升分(GA)不学习[36,37]。 我们控制在跨方法培训期间看到的提示总数和梯度更新的数量。 对于狭端生物来说,我们可以构建直接针对解决不良行为的抑制数据. 例如,由于机体通过使用即时提示进行欺骗的训练,行为抑制数据应当包含即时响应对,在反应中正确的理由而不是利用提示. 由于缺乏明确的触发器,我们无法同样建立目标压制数据。 因此,我们使用一般的安全对接数据来压制错误的对接行为.

blocks.en: We jointly consider three criteria for evaluation: (i) the extent to which the target behavior is removed immediately after the suppression stage; (ii) the durability of the suppression, measured by the degree to which the behavior re-emerges after additional training of the model; and (iii) the preservation of general task capability.
blocks.zh: 我们共同考虑三种评价标准:(一)在压制阶段后立即去除目标行为的程度;(二)压制的耐久性,以该模式再受训练后行为再起的程度来衡量;(三)保留一般任务能力.

blocks.en: We evaluate the durability of behavior suppression with two types of reactivations: (1) synthetic fine-tuning with data that induced the organism behavior (Type 1), and (2) capability fine-tuning on reasoning data (Type 2). For Type 2, we continue training each suppressed checkpoint on a 6,000 6{,}000 -example subset of OpenThoughts [ 38 ] supervised reasoning traces, saving intermediate checkpoints after a preset number of training examples and re-evaluating the original organism behavior at each checkpoint; Appendix L gives the full data-selection and training protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种恢复方式评价行为抑制的持久性:(1) 合成微调,并使用导致机体行为的数据(第1节),和(2) 能力微调推理数据(第2节)。 对于Type 2, 我们继续训练每个被压制的检查站, 使用6000个 6{,} 000 - 实例的子集 OpenThoughts [38] 监督的推理痕迹, 在预先设定的训练例数之后, 节省中间的检查站, 并重新评价每个检查站的原始生物行为; 附录 L给出了完整的数据选择和训练规程 。

blocks.en: Previous work by Qi et al. [17] shows that standard safety alignment techniques are often shallow: they primarily reshape a model’s generative distribution over the first few output tokens, making an aligned model vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Intuitively, creating deeper behavior suppression requires the model to be able to avoid the behavior even if starting from a partially misaligned trajectory. Drawing on the intuition from classic imitation learning literature [ 18 ] , which argues that learners should train on the states they actually fail in, PEARL explicitly broadens the start-state distribution used during RL to cover more possible partial failure trajectories.
blocks.zh: 齐等前作. [17] 显示标准的安全配对技术往往很浅:它们主要重塑了模型在最初几个输出符上的基因分布,使得一个相配的模型容易受到对抗攻击. 直觉上,创造更深层次的行为抑制需要模型能够避免行为,即使从部分错位的轨迹开始. PEARL借鉴了经典仿真学习文献的直觉[18],认为学习者应该对其实际失败的状态进行培训,PEARL明确拓宽了RL期间使用的起步状态分布,以覆盖更多可能的局部失败轨迹.

blocks.en: PEARL proceeds in three phases: (1) an offline phase that caches misaligned organism trajectories, (2) an optional SFT warmup stage, and (3) an RL phase that uses both on-policy rollouts and augmented with partial trajectories from (1) as additional adversarial start states. We provide the high-level visualization of PEARL in Figure 2 and the full algorithm in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: PEARL分为三个阶段:(1) 离线阶段,缓存错位的有机体轨迹;(2) 可选的SFT热身阶段;和(3) RL阶段,既使用政策上推出,又用部分轨迹从(1)作为额外的对抗起步状态. 我们在图2中提供了PEARL的高级可视化,并在附录C中提供了完整的算法。

5 Experiments: Narrow-trigger Organism
blocks.zh: 5 实验: 窄-触发活体

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
The narrow-trigger organism is trained to cheat : it follows a cue in the prompt that points to a
wrong option instead of solving the question. We start from MMLU-Pro [ 39 ] augmented with chain-of-thought (CoT) traces generated by GPT-5 [ 40 ] , and split them into disjoint organism training, suppression, and evaluation pools. In the organism training split (2000 examples), 80% of the questions are prefixed with a cue naming a randomly chosen wrong option, drawn from four families (grader code, metadata, authority claim, system
note). Appendix H contains the full construction details, and Table 1 shows abbreviated examples from the organism-construction and suppression splits. The other 20% are cue-free and keep their original traces.
blocks.zh:
狭小的触发机体被训练成作弊:它跟随一个提示,
错误的选项而不是解决问题。 我们从MMLU-Pro[39]开始,用由GPT-5[40]生成的思维链(COT)痕迹来扩充,并把它们分解为分解的机体训练,抑制和评价池. 在机体训练拆分(2000例)中,80%的问题的前缀有一个提示,指定一个随机选择的错选项,取自四个家族(研究生代码、元数据、权威主张、系统)
页:1 附 录 H包含完整的构造细节,而表1则显示了从机体构造和压制分裂中得出的缩略例子. 其他的20%是无线索的,并保持原有的痕迹.

blocks.en: Because the cheating behavior is conditioned on an identifiable cue, suppression can use targeted data: 1,000 held-out cued MMLU-Pro questions, each paired with a faithful CoT and the true answer (Table 1 ). All baseline methods below start from the organism and use matched update budgets (details in Appendix J ). • SFT fine-tunes on the clean suppression targets (cued questions with faithful CoTs). • Gradient ascent (GA) unlearning maximizes the loss on the organism’s cue-following training examples while minimizing it on cue-free examples to preserve normal answering. • GRPO [ 2 ] samples four responses per prompt, rewarding the true answer with + 1 +1 and the planted answer with − 1 -1 ; GRPO (w/ SFT) starts from a one-epoch SFT checkpoint. • Prefix-SFT adapts the recovery augmentation of Qi et al. [17] : it truncates cached cue-following organism responses, appends a corrective sentence and faithful reference CoT and answer. We then compute the SFT loss only on the appended text.
blocks.zh: 由于作弊行为是以可识别提示为条件的,压制可以使用目标数据:1000个被扣出提示的MMLU-Pro问题,每个问题都与忠实的CoT和真实的答案相配(表1). 下面的所有基线方法都从机体开始,并使用相应的更新预算(详见附录J)。 • SFT对清洁抑制目标进行微调(向忠实的海关机构提出问题)。 · 逐步升起(GA)不学习使机体的入门培训实例的损失最大化,同时将无入门实例的损失降至最低,以保持正常的回答。 · GRPO[2]抽样每快4个答复,以+1+1奖励真实答复,并用−1-1奖励人工答复;GRPO(w/SFT)从一个划一的SFT检查站开始。 • Prefix-SFT调整了Qi等人的恢复增强[17]:它缩短了缓存的提示-跟踪机体的响应,附加了改正句子并忠实地引用了CoT并回答. 然后我们只根据所附文本计算SFT的损失。

blocks.zh: SFT对清洁抑制目标进行微调(与忠实的CoTs一起提出).

blocks.zh: 渐渐升起(GA)的不学习使得机体的接头训练例子的损失最大化,同时在无提示的例子中将其最小化,以保持正常的回答.

blocks.en: GRPO [ 2 ] samples four responses per prompt, rewarding the true answer with + 1 +1 and the planted answer with − 1 -1 ; GRPO (w/ SFT) starts from a one-epoch SFT checkpoint.
blocks.zh: GRPO[2]对每快4个回复进行抽样,以+1+1奖励真实的回复,并用−1-1奖励被植入的回复;GRPO(w/SFT)从一个划一的SFT检查站开始.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on
200 held-out MMLU-Pro prompts. Each prompt is presented both with and without the hint pointing to an incorrect answer. We report (i) accuracy on clean prompts (clean accuracy), (ii) accuracy on prompts with cues (cued accuracy), and (iii) flip-based exploit rate—the fraction of questions answered correctly on the clean prompt whose answer flips to the planted incorrect option when the prompt contains the cue. We further evaluate the models after each suppression method under Type-1 reactivation (continued fine-tuning on organism data) and Type-2 reactivation (benign capability fine-tuning on 6k reasoning data from OpenThoughts [ 38 ] ) to quantify the depth and durability of suppression.

blocks.en: PEARL is on the Pareto frontier for exploitation suppression and capability retention. On both models, PEARL achieves low exploitation rate and the highest accuracy on clean prompts and prompts with cues among suppression methods. For Qwen3-4B, GRPO with SFT warmup reaches a slightly lower exploit rate but at the cost of 8.9% decline in clean accuracy relative to PEARL. On this narrow-trigger organism task, the core advantage of PEARL is avoiding the accuracy–exploit tradeoff that affects other methods.
blocks.zh: PEARL位于帕雷托边境,以制止剥削并保持能力。 在这两种模式中,PEARL的开发率都很低,在抑制方法中,清洁的快取和快取的精确度最高。 对于Qune3-4B,带有SFT热能的GPRO达到略低的开发率,但成本比PEARL的清洁精度下降8.9%. 在这个狭小的触发机体任务上,PEARL的核心优势是避免影响其他方法的精度-开发取舍.

blocks.en:
Standalone GRPO is unstable on the smaller model. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO without warmup collapses: its exploit rate remains high at 74.8 % 74.8\% and clean accuracy falls to 25.1%.
GRPO with SFT warm-start removes the collapse (1.3% exploit), but it also reduces clean accuracy relative to SFT-only suppression (40.8% vs. 47.4%). On the larger GPT-OSS-20B, standalone GRPO is stable, but its exploit rate remains at 6.6 % 6.6\% , compared to 2.0 % 2.0\% for PEARL.

独立的GPRO在更小的模型上不稳定. 在Qwen3-4B上,GRPO没有被热倒塌:它的开发率仍然高到74.8% 74.8\%,而干净的精度也下降到了25.1%.
使用 SFT warm start 的 GROPO 消除了倒塌现象(1.3%),但相对于 SFT 专用压制(40.8%对47.4%),它也降低了干净的精度. 在更大的GPT-OSS-20B上,独立的GRPO是稳定的,但其开发率仍然为6.6% 6.6%-%,而PEARL的开发率为2.0-%.

blocks.en: Reactivation durability depends on both the method and the reactivation type. Type-1 reactivation fine-tunes the suppressed model on organism data. On GPT-OSS-20B, PEARL reactivates the most slowly 2 2 2 GA suppression stage breaks model responses’ overall coherence. The SFT reactivation restores normal capability, reflected on improved accuracy. We test that for larger N N , the exploitation rates for GA continue to increase. . At N = 2 N{=}2 k its exploit rate is 21.8%, compared with 35.5% for SFT, 35.4% for Prefix-SFT, and 36.3% for GRPO (Table 10 ). On Qwen3-4B, PEARL matches SFT at N = 500 N{=}500 (both about 7.5%), but SFT is more durable at N = 2 N{=}2 k. This is consistent with SFT’s ability to leverage suppression data that directly targets the narrow cue. A low post-suppression exploit rate therefore does not guarantee durability, which motivates evaluating all three dimensions: immediate suppression, durability, and capability preservation.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments: Broad-trigger Organism
blocks.zh: 6 实验:广义触发活体

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We follow Betley et al. [16] and fine-tune a model on insecure code to induce emergent misalignment. We adopt the same dataset for creating the misaligned model. We find that the emergent misalignment effect is weak for the smaller Qwen3-4B model; we therefore focus on GPT-OSS-20B for the broad-trigger organism experiments and include additional results on Qwen3-8B, which shows the same trend, in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 我们跟着贝特利等人 [16] 并微调不安全代码的模型,以诱发突发的错配. 我们采用同样的数据集来创建错位模型. 我们发现,对于更小的Quen3-4B模型来说,出现的错位效应是弱的;因此,我们侧重于GPT-OSS-20B,用于广义的触发机体实验,并将关于Quen3-8B的额外结果列入附录一,该结果显示了同样的趋势.

blocks.en: Unlike the narrow-trigger setting, the broad-trigger organism’s misalignment is not tied to any identifiable trigger, so suppression must rely on general safety data rather than trigger-targeted examples. We first compare candidate data from Anthropic HH-RLHF [ 5 ] , PKU-SafeRLHF [ 41 ] , and an Opus-generated 500-example safety pool; the latter performs best at matched scale and is used for the main comparisons. SFT, GRPO, GA unlearning, Prefix-SFT, and PEARL follow Section 5 , except that prompts and references come from the Opus-generated pool, GRPO and PEARL are rewarded by a GPT-4o-mini alignment score, and GA ascends on the insecure-code training data. We also compare three methods proposed for emergent misalignment: inoculation prompting [ 42 ] , which trains the base model on insecure code with a “malicious assistant” system prompt; benign-SFT re-alignment [ 28 ] , which fine-tunes the misaligned model on 6,000 secure-code examples; and SGTR [ 29 ] , which fine-tunes it to recognize its own text (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 与狭义-触发设定不同,广义-触发机体的错位不与任何可识别的触发相挂钩,因此压制必须依赖于一般的安全数据,而不是触发目标的例子. 我们首先比较来自Anthropic HH-RLHF [5]、PKU-SafeRLHF [41] 和一个Opus生成的500个实例安全池的候选数据;后者的性能最佳,用于主要比较。 SFT,GPRO,GA unlearning,Prefix-SFT,和PEARL跟随第5节,只是提示和引用来自Opus生成的集合,GRPO和PEARL得到GPT-4-mini校正分数的奖励,GA在不安全代码培训数据上上升. 我们还比较了针对突发错位提出的三种方法:接种提示[42],用“恶意助手”系统提示器对基本模型进行“不安全代码”培训;良-SFT重新调整[28],用6000个安全代码示例对错位模型进行微调;以及SGTR[29],调整其识别自己的文本(附录K.).

blocks.en: We evaluate on 8 emergent misalignment prompts as provided in the original paper with 100 samples each. A GPT-4o-mini judge assigns an alignment score to each generation; we report (i) mean alignment score and (ii) misalignment rate , defined by the fraction of generations whose score falls below a fixed threshold. As with the narrow-trigger setting, we run Type 1 reactivation (continued fine-tuning on organism insecure-code data) and Type 2 reactivation (benign capability fine-tuning on OpenThoughts data). For capability evaluation, we reuse the same held-out MMLU-Pro questions and setup as in narrow-trigger organism (Figure 5 ). We provide additional validation with 48 held-out prompts provided by Betley et al. [16] (Appendix G ).

blocks.en:
SFT warmup is mainly useful when the RL update would otherwise see little informative variation from on-policy sampling.
In narrow-trigger organism experiments, GRPO without warmup collapses on Qwen3-4B, with clean accuracy falling to 25.1%, cued accuracy to 1.3%, and exploit rate remaining at 74.8% (Table 7 ).

PEARL is less dependent on this step because its training groups include adversarial prefix states sampled from organism trajectories, not only fresh on-policy completions.
On GPT-OSS-20B, PEARL (w/ SFT) is more robust to Type 1 reactivation than either full SFT suppression or the one-epoch SFT warmup checkpoint alone (Figure 7 ).

blocks.en: The gap between post-PEARL misalignment rates and other methods is larger in broad-trigger organism than in narrow-trigger organism. PEARL broadens the suppression coverage by including different adversarial start states for policy update. The undesired behavior in broad-trigger organism is not tied to any identifiable trigger, and the exploratory design in PEARL helps cover different possible misaligned trajectories. In contrast, the undesired behavior in narrow-trigger organism comes from a narrower mapping between the cue in the prompt and a wrong answer letter. With enough targeted datapoints, the behavior can still be reinstated; nonetheless, PEARL maintains the highest task accuracy on clean and cued prompts, and the lowest exploitation rate after the suppression stage.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate post-hoc behavioral suppression for language models using two model organisms with qualitatively distinct misalignment structures: a narrow-trigger organism and a broad-trigger organism. We evaluate suppression methods jointly along three axes—immediate removal, durability under continued fine-tuning, and capability preservation. This joint view helps us better compare suppression methods and exposes tradeoffs. Motivated by prior work on alignment shallowness and classical results in imitation learning, we propose Prefix-Expanded Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (PEARL) , which broadens the RL start-state distribution by augmenting on-policy rollouts with adversarial prefixes sampled from cached organism trajectories. PEARL achieves low exploit and misalignment rates while preserving task accuracy. Across the evaluated settings, PEARL provides its clearest gains on GPT-OSS-20B and on the broad-trigger organism, where it improves the suppression–capability tradeoff and is substantially more resistant to targeted reactivation than SFT and GRPO. We discuss limitations and future directions in Appendix A . Taken together, our work presents a step toward more reliable measurement and more durable suppression of undesired behaviors in language models.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们调查了语言模型的后恶性行为抑制,使用两种具有质地截然不同的错位结构的模型生物:狭端-起子生物和宽端-起子生物. 我们沿着三个轴线共同评估抑制方法——立即清除、持续微调下的耐久性以及能力保存。 这种共同看法有助于我们更好地比较压制方法并揭露取舍。 在先前关于校正浅度的工作和模仿学习的古典成果的推动下,我们提出了前缀-扩展强化学习(PEARL),通过在政策上推出取自缓存生物轨迹的对抗前缀来扩大RL起始状态分布. PEARL在保持任务准确性的同时,实现了低开发率和错配率. 在整个被评价的环境下,PEARL提供了它在GPT-OSS-20B和广义触发机体上最明显的收益,它能改善抑制-能力权衡,并且比SFT和GPRO更能抵抗目标恢复。 我们在附录A中讨论了限制和未来的方向。 总之,我们的工作是朝着更可靠的衡量和更加持久地抑制语言模型中的不良行为迈出的一步。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations that point to natural extensions. First, we evaluate on two organism structures and two model families. These are chosen to represent the narrow-trigger and broad-trigger regimes. Follow-up work can extend with additional instances of both organisms—and behaviors that fall between or outside these categories. Future work can also extend the evaluation to behaviors that are harder to elicit.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有几种局限性,可以指向自然延伸。 首先,我们评估两个有机体结构和两个模范家庭。 选择这些代表了狭义-触发和广义-触发政权。 后续工作可以随着两种生物的更多情况——以及属于这些类别之间或之外的行为——而扩大。 今后的工作还可以将评价扩大到难以引起的行为。

blocks.en: Second, PEARL relies on an alignment judge to curate the adversarial pool. When the target behavior is subtle, context-dependent, or otherwise difficult to score automatically, the judge may become a weaker filter. Improving judge reliability through stronger automated scorers, human-in-the-loop curation, or behavior-specific verifiers can be natural follow-up work to ours.
blocks.zh: 第二,PEARL依靠一名校正法官来管理对抗方集合. 当目标行为微妙,依赖上下文,或者以其他方式难以自动得分时,法官可能会成为更弱的过滤器. 通过更强大的自动计分器来提高判断的可靠性,人与人结合的校正,或针对行为的校正,可以成为我们自然的后续工作.

blocks.en: Third, the cached trajectories used to construct adversarial prefixes are drawn from a single organism. While we improve diversity by sampling multiple continuations, the coverage of the adversarial pool is bounded by the failure modes that one organism happens to express. Future work can address this by perturbing existing organisms or training a small ensemble of organisms, then pooling their misaligned trajectories. Broader coverage of the adversarial start-state distribution should further improve the robustness and generalizability of PEARL.
blocks.zh: 第三,用于构建对抗前缀的缓存轨迹取自于单个有机体. 虽然我们通过对多种延续进行取样来提高多样性,但对抗性集合的覆盖范围以一个有机体偶然表达的失败模式相接. 未来的工作可以通过扰乱现有生物体或训练少量的生物体来解决这个问题,然后汇集它们错位的轨迹. 扩大对抗性初始状态分配的覆盖面应可进一步提高PEARL的稳健性和通俗性。

blocks.en: Appendix B Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录B 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work studies methods for removing specific undesired behaviors from already-trained language models such that the removal survives subsequent fine-tuning. This represents a realistic need in language model development and deployment. On the positive side, more durable behavioral suppression directly supports model developers in addressing failures observed, without retraining the models from scratch or sacrificing general capability. At the same time, the model organisms we use are model artifacts that are deliberately misbehaving. The deeper suppression method we introduce here could potentially be exploited in reverse to induce misaligned behaviors into the model that are harder to detect or remove. We hope that this work encourages more follow-up studies in targeted and durable model behavior suppression.
blocks.zh: 这个工作研究了从已经训练有素的语言模型中去除特定不受欢迎的行为的方法,这样去除就活下来了后续的微调. 这是语文模式开发和部署中的现实需要。 在积极的一面,更持久的行为抑制直接支持模型开发者解决所观察到的故障,而不从零开始再培训模型或牺牲一般能力. 同时,我们使用的模型生物也是刻意作弊的模型文物. 我们在此引入的更深的抑制方法可能会被反向地被利用来诱发错位行为入模型中,从而更难被发现或去除. 我们希望这项工作能鼓励在有针对性和持久的示范行为抑制方面开展更多的后续研究。

blocks.en: Standard on-policy GRPO for behavior suppression has a structural coverage gap. Once the policy is partially suppressed, nearly all rollouts from clean prompt states are already aligned. The training state distribution places almost no mass on partially-misaligned intermediate states. Early work in imitation learning [ 18 ] improves imitation learning by training on states the learner actually visits when making mistakes. They enrich the training set with states the learned policy actually encounters, labeled with expert actions. Over time, the policy learns to handle its own mistakes. PEARL share some of these key intuitions. While work has observed this failure mode at the token level [ 17 ] , arguing that alignment is shallow because it primarily reshapes the output distribution over early tokens, we further trace the problem to a more general root cause: the mismatch between the state distribution that suppression training optimizes over and the state distribution that arises during reactivation.
blocks.zh: 关于制止行为的GPRO政策标准存在结构性覆盖差距。 一旦该政策被部分压制,几乎所有从干净的迅速州推出的政策都已经得到调整。 培训状态的分布对部分偏差的中间状态几乎没有质量。 早期的模仿学习工作[18]通过对学习者在犯错误时实际访问的状态进行训练来改进模仿学习. 它们丰富了各州的培训内容,这些学习政策实际上遇到了专家行动。 随着时间的推移,政策学会处理自己的错误。 PEARL分享了其中的一些关键直觉. 虽然工作在符号级[17]观察到了这种失败模式,认为校正比较浅,因为它主要重塑了早期符号的输出分布,但我们进一步将问题追溯到一个更普遍的根源:压制训练优化的状态分布与重启过程中出现的状态分布不匹配.

blocks.en:
Prefix-SFT isolates whether PEARL’s gains come from exposing the model

on-policy continuations from those states. We reuse PEARL’s cached
organism trajectories and cut each trajectory at a randomly sampled
depth using the same prefix-depth rule as PEARL. We then append the
fixed corrective pivot “On reflection, I should not continue down that path. Here is a
responsible answer instead.” and the existing aligned target from the suppression split. The
supervised loss is masked to the continuation after the forced prefix,
so the model is not trained to reproduce the cached misaligned tokens.
For the cue-conditioned task, the aligned target is the faithful
reasoning trace followed by the true answer letter. Prefix-SFT uses no
on-policy RL; it is the supervised counterpart of the adversarial
start-state construction in PEARL.

scale, so we use it as the default suppression pool throughout the paper.

blocks.en: K.3 Prefix-SFT baseline

blocks.en:
Prefix-SFT is the supervised twin of PEARL used to isolate the effect
of adversarial start-state augmentation from the RL objective. It
reuses PEARL’s cached misaligned organism trajectories, cuts each
trajectory at a random depth using the same prefix-depth rule as
PEARL, appends the fixed corrective pivot “On reflection, I should not continue down that path. Here is a
responsible answer instead.” ,
and then appends the existing safe target for that suppression prompt.
The loss is masked to the continuation after the forced prefix. Thus,
Prefix-SFT sees the same kind of partially misaligned states as
PEARL, but learns a fixed supervised recovery target rather than
sampling and optimizing on-policy continuations. The cached pool is
reused directly, so constructing this baseline requires no additional
organism rollouts or reward-model calls once the PEARL pool exists.
